notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's year-end 2024 holdings data file ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); the same line in NBIM's equity CSV download (https://www.nbim.no/api/investments/v2/report/?assetType=eq&date=2024-12-31&fileType=csv) reads "North America;United States;Alphabet Inc;Technology;332448846184;29271691564;0.88%;1.26%". CalPERS: the source is CalPERS's 13F-HR/A (restatement) for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, filed April 23, 2025; its information table is identical to the original 13F-HR filed February 12, 2025. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS: CalPERS lists Class A (GOOGL) and Class C (GOOG) separately; Alphabet's classes have equal economic rights, so both are summed and divided by all three classes. Holders of record: Class A (GOOGL) only; the 10-K also gives 1,671 holders of record of Class C and approximately 57 of Class B.
